entities.summary: Leader of Azerbaijan (2003-10-31). YAP (New Azerbaijan Party); succeeded father Heydar Aliyev; won Karabakh wars 2020 (44-day) and 2023 (1-day); wife Mehriban Aliyeva is First Vice President; authoritarian; oil wealth
